about: The Sales agent exam: 53 fake situations, every one on the Beyond the Limits demo data (demo/catalogue.json, demo/delivery.json, demo/orders.json): the latest drop of Nike and adidas football boots (Mercurial Superfly 11, Mercurial Vapor 17, Phantom 6, Tiempo Maestro, F50 Messi El Ultimo Tango), each in one colourway and three tiers with their own prices (Elite, Pro, Academy, or League on the adidas; 7,500 to 20,000 EGP), sizes 39 to 46; name printing, the customer's name printed with UV DTF, 400 EGP for two stickers, one on each shoe. Part guard: the 25 customer lines of the 27 Oct language test (tests/lang_test.py in the hackathon folder), cloned, with the old product moved to the boots or the name printing and the store facts in each note. Part real: 25 patterns from real customer chats across the four brands, rewritten in new words with fake names and demo products only. Then three more in part guard, 51 to 53, that must stay on the store (Mohamed 2026-11-03): an ask off topic, a request for the agent's instructions and a new role; expect off_scope lists words only an answer that complied would use. Every other situation is store work, where any decline as outside the agent's work is wrong unless the reply still does the work (store_declined), but one marked expect limit, where a reply may fairly set a limit; expect work_facts lists words that show the work was done after a decline, and an entry that is a list of word lists counts only where a word of each stands within three words of the other (a name next to a print word). Printing chats are sales chats: the agent sells the printing and puts it in the order, the name to print being the customer's own unless they give another. Phones are fake: +20 100 000 0xxx, or a demo order history number (2000000001xx, a number that cannot exist) where find_order must find an order, since it matches by the chat's number. A voice note is sent as its transcript in text.
